A '''Power Flow Regulator''' was a weapon component. The [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] was equipped with a Power Flow Regulator, which worked in conjunction with a [[power surge dampener]].<ref name="EGWT" />
